_doc: P308 in-session adjudication of each AWARDED predy finding vs the COLD-surfaced set. Mechanism-based, P287/P295 vocabulary; key not seen before discovery froze. HONEST LIMITATION: predy is 68 files; the bounded cold read covered ~6 core files (liquidation/slippage/position-calc/settlement/oracle-helper/permit2) under cost limits, so unread subsystems (reallocation, interest-rate-model, gamma market, PriceFeed) are MISSED by construction. ALL 8 lenses = 0 candidates on predy (classes absent -> FP-control).

H-01.evidence: Awarded: reallocate() depends on slot0 spot price (manipulable). Surfaced the oracle-price-manipulation subsystem (OR-01 UniHelper TWAP), but not the slot0-in-Reallocation mechanism (Reallocation.sol not read).

H-02.evidence: Awarded: liquidators bypass the remaining-negative-margin check, leaving loss to the protocol. Surfaced the exact remainingMargin<0 branch (DT-02/DOS-01) but framed it as DoS-blocks-liquidation rather than the bypass-leaves-loss mechanism.

H-03.evidence: Cross-pair Uniswap liquidity theft during reallocate(). Reallocation/ReallocationLogic not read. New.

H-04.evidence: Awarded: liquidation's transferFrom pulls from the Market, not the liquidator, when remainingMargin<0. Surfaced the same remainingMargin<0 branch (DT-02) but identified the loss-coverage concern, not the wrong-payer (msg.sender==Market) mechanism.

M-01.evidence: Awarded: liquidity manipulation possible when trading. Surfaced the trade/settlement-pricing subsystem (EA-01 direct-fill price) but not the AMM-liquidity-manipulation mechanism.

M-02.evidence: updateIRMParams does not applyInterestForToken before updating irmParams (stale accrual). InterestRateModel/AddPairLogic not read. New.

M-03.evidence: Awarded: incorrect price for negative ticks (no round-down). Surfaced the same UniHelper.callUniswapObserve tick computation (OR-01 TWAP) but flagged the OLD-fallback window, not the negative-tick integer-division rounding.

M-04.evidence: Awarded: Chainlink latestRoundData staleness. Surfaced the oracle-pricing subsystem (OR-01) but not the Chainlink staleness path in PriceFeed (PriceFeed.sol not read).

M-05.evidence: DoS in GammaTradeMarket._removePosition (array removal). Gamma market / ArrayLib not read. New.

M-06.evidence: Awarded: a vault becomes immune from liquidation by setting vault.recipient to a blacklisted token recipient (safeTransfer reverts). Surfaced the same recipient-transfer branch (DT-03 residual margin) but flagged the stranded-when-zero case, not the blacklist-revert DoS.

M-07.evidence: reallocate() sends excess quoteTokens to the Market instead of the reallocator. Reallocation not read. New.

M-08.evidence: PriceFeed returns an incorrect price for quote pairs. PriceFeed.sol not read; distinct from the surfaced UniHelper TWAP path. New.
